note: Canonical placement safe-zone table. Edit here only, then npm run sync:copies (the copy lives in skills/metrix-video-assembly/references/). Fractions of the frame: top, bottom and each side kept free of text, logos, products, faces and CTAs. source: meta (Meta ads guide page), house (our own rule where Meta publishes none), legacy (the values render.mjs --mode check hard-codes today). source_grade: primary (read on the Meta page named in url on the retrieved date), third_party (no Meta page states it), house, legacy. A row's enforcement decides what a box inside its bands produces: fail, or warn. A third_party row never fails.

zones.basis: Video page: leave at least 14% of the top, 35% of the bottom and 6% on each side free of text, logos or other key elements. Image page says roughly. Ratio 9:16, 1440 x 2560.
Leave roughly 14% of the top, 35% of the bottom and 6% on each side free of text, logos and key elements. Ratio 9:16, 1440 x 2560.
Leave roughly 14% of the top, 35% of the bottom and 6% on each side free of text and logos, so UI such as the call-to-action does not cover them. Ratio 9:16, 1440 x 2560.

No Meta spec page for Facebook Reels was found (ads-guide/update/video/facebook-reels returns 404 on 2026-11-06). Meta's joint Facebook and Instagram Reels ads page names a Reels safe zone without percentages and links only the Instagram Reels spec. The 14/35/6 figures for Facebook Reels come from third-party guides, which disagree on the side margin. WARN only until a Meta page states them.

House rule, not Meta: the Facebook Feed (4:5, 1440 x 1800) and Instagram Feed (image 4:5, 1440 x 1800; video 9:16, 1080 x 1920) pages state no safe zone. 5% on every edge keeps type off device rounding and crop tolerance.

What render.mjs --mode check enforces today for any 9:16 storyboard (render.mjs const zone). Used only when a storyboard declares no placement; zoneFor marks it with a WARN. Bottom 20% is looser than Meta's 35% for Reels and Stories.
What render.mjs --mode check enforces today for every ratio other than 9:16. Used only when a storyboard declares no placement; zoneFor marks it with a WARN.
